about: Yard kit pieces drawn with a Fab model instead of our own (car_wreck: City Sample's crushed vehicle07) (beenster, Nov 10: 'cant you pick the vehicles from the fab packs we downloaded?'). Source/TorqueShedProto/Shed/TorqueFurniture.cpp DressFab: the piece's own mesh still collides, is looked at and outlined, but isn't drawn; each copy of the Fab mesh is turned so its long side lies along the box's, scaled (uniformly) to the box's length, centred on [x, y] (cm, the piece's frame: x across, y to its front), stood on the ground and turned by yaw. A Fab mesh that isn't in the project (or isn't cooked) leaves our own model drawn. The packs live in /Content (never committed): City Sample Vehicles and Vehicle Variety Pack vol 1, both in beenster's Fab library. No brand names or logos in either. paint: our MI_Prop_<key> (materials.json) put over every slot whose base material's name has 'Paint' in it (City Sample's car paint is black without its Blueprint), one key a copy in turn; each slot is logged once.
